FFmpeg configure:
  ./configure --prefix=out/windows-x86_64 --enable-shared --disable-static --enable-pic --disable-autodetect --disable-everything --disable-network --disable-debug --disable-doc --disable-programs --enable-ffmpeg --enable-w32threads --enable-zlib --enable-libopenh264 --enable-libsvtav1 --enable-libdav1d --enable-protocol='file,pipe' --enable-demuxer='mov,wav,flac,mp3,ogg,aac,matroska' --enable-muxer='mp4,mov,null' --enable-decoder='h264,hevc,prores,libdav1d,av1,mjpeg,png' --enable-decoder='aac,aac_fixed,alac,flac,mp3,mp3float,vorbis,opus' --enable-decoder='pcm_s16le,pcm_s16be,pcm_s24le,pcm_s24be,pcm_s32le,pcm_s32be,pcm_f32le,pcm_f32be,pcm_f64le,pcm_u8,pcm_alaw,pcm_mulaw' --enable-parser='h264,hevc,av1,aac,mpegaudio,flac,vorbis,opus,mjpeg,png' --enable-bsfs --enable-encoder='aac,libopenh264,libsvtav1' --enable-filter='buffer,buffersink,abuffer,abuffersink,format,aformat,null,anull,scale,aresample,setpts,asetpts,trim,atrim,fps,copy,hwupload,hwdownload' --extra-ldflags='-static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -LD:/a/ffmpeg-lgpl/ffmpeg-lgpl/build/windows-x86_64/static-libs' --enable-mediafoundation --enable-d3d11va --enable-dxva2 --enable-ffnvcodec --enable-nvenc --enable-nvdec --enable-cuda --enable-amf --enable-libvpl --enable-encoder='h264_mf,hevc_mf,h264_nvenc,hevc_nvenc,h264_amf,hevc_amf,h264_qsv,hevc_qsv' --enable-hwaccel='h264_d3d11va,h264_d3d11va2,hevc_d3d11va,hevc_d3d11va2,av1_d3d11va,av1_d3d11va2,h264_dxva2,hevc_dxva2,h264_nvdec,hevc_nvdec,av1_nvdec' --extra-cflags=-Iout/windows-x86_64/include --extra-ldflags=-Lout/windows-x86_64/lib
